root: Uni-CLI 0.227.0 gives all Node HTTP execution one proxy owner: fetch and dispatcher come from the same Undici package across pipelines, OAuth, downloads, extraction, cascade, and the public HTTP transport.
Repair is now a bounded exact-command verifier with no hidden npm, git, or agent mutation; envelope truth, oracle evidence, and process exit code agree.
Live cookies remain in memory unless the user explicitly exports them. POSIX persistence is atomic and owner-only, and empty export fails with an auth_required envelope instead of false success.
Node 22/24 CI, deterministic integration, the canonical release gate, production audit, generated action ownership, and separated live/fixture evidence keep public claims tied to executable results.
zh: Uni-CLI 0.227.0 为全部 Node HTTP 执行建立单一代理所有者：pipeline、OAuth、download、extract、cascade 与公共 HTTP transport 的 fetch 和 dispatcher 均来自同一 Undici 包。
repair 现在是有界的原命令 verifier，不再隐藏执行 npm、git 或 agent mutation；envelope、oracle evidence 与 process exit code 表达同一真值。
实时 cookie 默认只留在内存，只有用户显式导出才会落盘；POSIX 持久化具备 atomic write 与 owner-only 权限，空导出以 auth_required 失败而不是假成功。
Node 22/24 CI、deterministic integration、统一 release gate、production audit、自动生成的 action ownership，以及分离的 live/fixture evidence 共同约束所有公开声明。
